terra.problem: “Jobab the king” says this was before any king reigned over Israel, but Genesis 36:32–35 does not state that. Include Genesis 36:31 in the passage reference.
Jobab was from Bozrah, but the passage does not say he became king there. The moment should not imply that his succession happened in Bozrah.
“One coming from Bozrah” describes someone coming from the city, not an event stated to happen in it. Also, Isaiah asks who is coming; the passage does not explicitly say he sees a vision.
Words such as “vindication,” “desolation,” and “citadels” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Use simpler words or briefly explain them.
